items.statement: Independent candidate discrimination supports a near-orthogonal central-bond torsional TS as the connecting ground-state route.
items.expected: The selected, validated route passes through a roughly 92.5-degree C(CO)-C(alpha)-C(beta)-C1 TS and has similar high barriers in gas and implicit acetonitrile.

items.statement: The high ground-state barrier makes ambient thermal interconversion unlikely within model limitations.
items.expected: The result is interpreted as thermal kinetic hindrance, while explicitly excluding direct claims about experimental rates or photochemical excited-state dynamics.
